debrief db-021
1) the actor r-e-f-r-a-m-e-d the d-r-u-g-b-a-t-c-h as m-ed-i-c-i-n-e and l-e-f-t a d-r-a-f-t n-o-t-e whi-le s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y r-e-v-i-e-w
2) the actor t-a-m-p-e-r-e-d the c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n d-a-t-a and l-e-f-t a f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d l-o-g whi-le i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g the t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e a-l-e-r-t-s
3) the actor d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e-d s-e-r-i-a-l i-d-s and l-e-f-t a m-i-s-m-a-t-c-h e-x-p-o-r-t whi-le b-y-p-a-s-i-n-g the s-t-a-t-u-s v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
4) the actor r-o-u-t-e-d p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l u-n-i-t-s to p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y a-c-c-e-s-s and l-e-f-t a d-r-o-p-p-o-i-n-t n-o-t-e whi-le s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n a-u-d-i-t
5) the actor d-e-l-a-y-e-d the r-e-p-o-r-t to r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-s and l-e-f-t a h-i-d-d-e-n m-e-m-o whi-le i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g the o-b-l-i-g-a-t-o-r-y d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e
